description: Use when someone wants gift ideas for a given budget and recipient, such as employees, clients or a law firm's clients. Returns up to 5 picks from Corporate Gift Picks guides, each with the item name, a price band, a one-line reason it fits, and a link to the guide. It shows price bands rather than current prices.

budget_band.description: Per-person price band in US dollars. If the user gives an amount, pick the band that contains it, or call estimate_gift_budget first.

recipient.description: Who the gift is for. Leave it out for general picks.

name: find_gift_picks
title: Find gift picks
